domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of facizers where I need to arrange the facizers into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

   Pick up a facizer
   Unstack a facizer from on top of another facizer
   Put down a facizer
   Stack a facizer on top of another facizer

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only pick up or unstack one facizer at a time.
   I can only pick up or unstack a facizer if my hand is empty.
   I can only pick up a facizer if the facizer is on the table and the facizer is clear. A facizer is clear if the facizer has no other facizers on top of it and if the facizer is not picked up.
   I can only unstack a facizer from on top of another facizer if the facizer I am unstacking was really on top of the other facizer.
   I can only unstack a facizer from on top of another facizer if the facizer I am unstacking is clear.
   Once I pick up or unstack a facizer, I am holding the facizer.
   I can only put down a facizer that I am holding.
   I can only stack a facizer on top of another facizer if I am holding the facizer being stacked.
   I can only stack a facizer on top of another facizer if the facizer onto which I am stacking the facizer is clear.
   Once I put down or stack a facizer, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you stack a facizer on top of a second facizer, the second facizer is no longer clear.

   Pick up a [noun_3]
   Unstack a [noun_3] from on top of another [noun_3]
   Put down a [noun_3]
   Stack a [noun_3] on top of another [noun_3]

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only pick up or unstack one [noun_3] at a time.
   I can only pick up or unstack a [noun_3] if my hand is empty.
   I can only pick up a [noun_3] if the [noun_3] is on the table and the [noun_3] is clear. A [noun_3] is clear if the [noun_3] has no other [noun_3][plural] on top of it and if the [noun_3] is not picked up.
   I can only unstack a [noun_3] from on top of another [noun_3] if the [noun_3] I am unstacking was really on top of the other [noun_3].
   I can only unstack a [noun_3] from on top of another [noun_3] if the [noun_3] I am unstacking is clear.
   Once I pick up or unstack a [noun_3], I am holding the [noun_3].
   I can only put down a [noun_3] that I am holding.
   I can only stack a [noun_3] on top of another [noun_3] if I am holding the [noun_3] being stacked.
   I can only stack a [noun_3] on top of another [noun_3] if the [noun_3] onto which I am stacking the [noun_3] is clear.
   Once I put down or stack a [noun_3], my hand becomes empty.
   Once you stack a [noun_3] on top of a second [noun_3], the second [noun_3] is no longer clear.

   I can only stack a scringent on top of another scringent if I am holding the scringent being stacked.
   I can only stack a scringent on top of another scringent if the scringent onto which I am stacking the scringent is clear.
   Once I put down or stack a scringent, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you stack a scringent on top of a second scringent, the second scringent is no longer clear.

   Pick up a uncillown
   Unstack a uncillown from on top of another uncillown
   Put down a uncillown
   Stack a uncillown on top of another uncillown

   Once I pick up or unstack a uncillown, I am holding the uncillown.
   I can only put down a uncillown that I am holding.
   I can only stack a uncillown on top of another uncillown if I am holding the uncillown being stacked.
   I can only stack a uncillown on top of another uncillown if the uncillown onto which I am stacking the uncillown is clear.
   Once I put down or stack a uncillown, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you stack a uncillown on top of a second uncillown, the second uncillown is no longer clear.

   Stack a torpho on top of another torpho

   I can only stack a torpho on top of another torpho if I am holding the torpho being stacked.
   I can only stack a torpho on top of another torpho if the torpho onto which I am stacking the torpho is clear.
   Once I put down or stack a torpho, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you stack a torpho on top of a second torpho, the second torpho is no longer clear.

   Once I pick up or unstack a [noun_3], I am holding the [noun_3].
   I can only put down a [noun_3] that I am holding.
   I can only stack a [noun_3] on top of another [noun_3] if I am holding the [noun_3] being stacked.
   I can only stack a [noun_3] on top of another [noun_3] if the [noun_3] onto which I am stacking the [noun_3] is clear.
   Once I put down or stack a [noun_3], my hand becomes empty.
   Once you stack a [noun_3] on top of a second [noun_3], the second [noun_3] is no longer clear.

   I can only stack a [noun_3] on top of another [noun_3] if I am holding the [noun_3] being stacked.
   I can only stack a [noun_3] on top of another [noun_3] if the [noun_3] onto which I am stacking the [noun_3] is clear.

domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of whators where I need to arrange the whators into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

   Pick up a whator
   Unstack a whator from on top of another whator
   Put down a whator
   Stack a whator on top of another whator

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only pick up or unstack one whator at a time.
   I can only pick up or unstack a whator if my hand is empty.
   I can only pick up a whator if the whator is on the table and the whator is clear. A whator is clear if the whator has no other whators on top of it and if the whator is not picked up.
   I can only unstack a whator from on top of another whator if the whator I am unstacking was really on top of the other whator.

   Once I pick up or unstack a whator, I am holding the whator.
   I can only put down a whator that I am holding.
   I can only stack a whator on top of another whator if I am holding the whator being stacked.
   I can only stack a whator on top of another whator if the whator onto which I am stacking the whator is clear.
   Once I put down or stack a whator, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you stack a whator on top of a second whator, the second whator is no longer clear.

   Put down a [noun_3]
   Stack a [noun_3] on top of another [noun_3]

   I can only pick up or unstack one [noun_3] at a time.
   I can only pick up or unstack a [noun_3] if my hand is empty.

   Once I pick up or unstack a [noun_3], I am holding the [noun_3].
   I can only put down a [noun_3] that I am holding.
   I can only stack a [noun_3] on top of another [noun_3] if I am holding the [noun_3] being stacked.
   I can only stack a [noun_3] on top of another [noun_3] if the [noun_3] onto which I am stacking the [noun_3] is clear.
   Once I put down or stack a [noun_3], my hand becomes empty.
   Once you stack a [noun_3] on top of a second [noun_3], the second [noun_3] is no longer clear.

   I can only stack a [noun_3] on top of another [noun_3] if I am holding the [noun_3] being stacked.
   I can only stack a [noun_3] on top of another [noun_3] if the [noun_3] onto which I am stacking the [noun_3] is clear.

   I can only put down a [noun_3] that I am holding.
   I can only stack a [noun_3] on top of another [noun_3] if I am holding the [noun_3] being stacked.
   I can only stack a [noun_3] on top of another [noun_3] if the [noun_3] onto which I am stacking the [noun_3] is clear.
   Once I put down or stack a [noun_3], my hand becomes empty.
   Once you stack a [noun_3] on top of a second [noun_3], the second [noun_3] is no longer clear.
